page.overview:
Who is Dr. Troy?

Dr. Troy resides in northwestern Lynna City. He will inform Link on various creatures in the game. Once Link defeats Veran, Dr. Troy will travel to the Target Carts game on Rolling Ridge to study Gorons.

In a Linked Game in , Dr. Troy's student will appear in Holodrum next to Guru-Guru on top of the Windmill near Horon Village. He will ask Link to tell a Secret to his teacher in Labrynna. Once Link tells the Secret to Dr. Troy, the biologist will thank Link for the update, and will offer him a "gift" if he can get a perfect score in the Target Carts mini-game. After successfully completing the mini-game, Dr. Troy will give Link the Bombchus.

"Just between us, I have seen an animal called Ricky that can jump small holes and cliffs by just moving toward them!" "Just between us, I have seen an animal called Ricky that can unleash powerful punches that sometimes cause whirlwinds!" "Just between us, I have seen an animal called Dimitri that eats many things--even monsters!" "Just between us, I have seen an animal called Dimitri that swims very well. It swims up even mighty currents with great ease!" "Just between us, I have seen an animal called Dimitri that can be lifted, carried and even thrown about!" "Just between us, I have seen an animal called Moosh that can hover in the air for short spans of time!" "Just between us, I have seen an animal called Moosh that can save up energy as it floats and then pound the ground with great force!" "Just between us, I have seen certain kinds of Deku Scrubs that actually engage in business! They're called Business Scrubss!" "Just between us, I have seen a monster called a Whisp that jinxes you when you touch it. You can't take your sword out when it happens! How frightful!" "Just between us, I have seen a terrifying monster that eats shields! How frightful!"
